end-dead.title: Flatline
text: The sea takes the crew, one chrome light at a time.
A Meridian cutter finds the Mirasol drifting at dawn. It files her as salvage.

end-shut.title: A User-Interface Defect
text: Marcus reads the ledger twice, then makes the call he has put off for five years. Detective Lim takes the Desk's letter and a statement. The Kelp Line loses its berth.
The door under the sea stays shut. Somewhere, a flat voice files the whole matter as a user-interface defect.

end-sold.title: Faceless Chits
text: Marcus counts the cores into a case and does not ask who. The Desk pays in chits with the faces ground off. Fifteen percent comes off the top, as agreed.
The door under the sea stays shut, for now. You do not know what the cores are for. You are careful not to find out.

end-quiet.title: A Quiet Account
text: You tell Marcus the tower is deep and the door is shut. He nods as if that were an answer.
Out on the water, a Meridian cutter sweeps its light across the Shoals, and on.
